profile.address: Avenida de la Industria 15, 28108 Alcobendas, Madrid, Spain
profile.reading:
This facility is part of Data4's Madrid data center campus, one of ten campuses the French-headquartered, pan-European colocation operator runs across France, Italy, Spain, Poland, Germany, and Greece, totaling roughly 165,000 square meters of IT space and 1.5 GW of power capacity company-wide, per Data4's own site. The OpenStreetMap record for this building carried no operator name prior to this update; this registry corrects that gap directly, since the building's own designation, MAD1-DC02, is an exact match to Data4's published Madrid campus building-naming convention.

Data4's Madrid presence spans two distinct sites: MAD1, in Alcobendas at Avenida de la Industria 15, and MAD2, in San Agustín del Guadalix, a separate site north of Madrid. This building, MAD1-DC02, is the second data hall built on the Alcobendas site, part of a campus that has grown to include at least three numbered buildings there (MAD1-DC01 through MAD1-DC03, all tracked as separate rows in this registry) alongside the newer, separate MAD2 site.

Data4 markets its data centers on modular, scalable design principles, sustainability commitments including free-cooling systems suited to the Iberian climate, and connectivity to major European internet exchange points; the Madrid market itself has grown substantially as a European data center hub in recent years alongside Data4's French home market. This registry has not located Data4's own building-by-building capacity or square-footage disclosure for MAD1-DC02 specifically, so no it_capacity_mw or technical_space_sqft figure is asserted for this individual building; Data4 discloses these figures at the company and campus level rather than per building in its public materials found this session. Alcobendas sits in the northern Madrid metropolitan area, a well-established business and technology corridor that has long attracted corporate back-office and telecom infrastructure investment.
